caseName: Johnson v. M. G. West Co.
caseNameFull: Johnson, Treasurer of California v. M. G. West Co.
attorneys: Messrs. U. S. Webb and H. H. Linney for appellants. Mr. Richard W. Young for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the District Court of Appeal, 3d Appellate District, of California.

Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellee to *639dismiss the appeal is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Section 237 (a), Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925, 43 Stat. 936, 937. The petition for certiorari is denied.

Messrs. U. S. Webb and H. H. Linney for appellants. Mr. Richard W. Young for appellee.
